explanation: Abraham's nephew who lived in Sodom and was saved by God before the city's destruction.
A biblical city destroyed by God because of its sinful inhabitants.
Another city destroyed together with Sodom by God for the same reason.
Heavenly beings sent by God to rescue Lot and his family and to destroy Sodom and Gomorrah.
Violation of God's commands and morality, which led to the destruction of Sodom and Gomorrah.
What Lot's wife was turned into when she looked back at Sodom, against the angels' warning.
The place where Lot and his daughters sought refuge after the destruction of Sodom and Gomorrah.
Sexual relations between close relatives, which occurred between Lot and his daughters in order to continue their lineage.
